mechanism_narrative: Sequential weekly gains in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES since t-3w signal commuter and shopper return, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to its mean over the last 28 days despite TRANSIT and WORKPLACES continuing to improve.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT crosses above -30 percent, it confirms restored commuting capacity, which pulls RETAIL_REC upward in the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT > -30.0 in any week after t-0w
failure_condition: TRANSIT crosses above -30.0 but mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than or equal to its mean over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A joint move of WORKPLACES toward baseline and RESIDENTIAL away from baseline indicates workers leaving home; this interaction raises retail-and-recreation footfall over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises above -13.0 and RESIDENTIAL falls below 6.0
failure_condition: WORKPLACES rises above -13.0 while RESIDENTIAL falls below 6.0, yet mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a renewed tightening regime, TRANSIT and WORKPLACES deteriorate, reducing discretionary retail trips and pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls by more than 5 points week-on-week
failure_condition: In a renewed tightening regime, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than or equal to its mean over the last 28 days despite TRANSIT falling more than 5 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: Spring weather lifts PARKS above 0; outdoor recreation substitutes for indoor retail, so weeks with PARKS above 0 precede lower RETAIL_REC over the next week.
failure_condition: When PARKS exceeds 0.0, RETAIL_REC over the following week is not lower than the prior week.

mechanism_narrative: The weekly improvement in RETAIL_REC is decelerating from +2.1 to +0.3 points; mean reversion and exhausted reopening gains cause RETAIL_REC to flatten or fall over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than over the last 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM less negative than -3.0 signals normalized shopping routines, reducing stock-up trips and freeing spend for retail-and-recreation over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM exceeds -3.0 but mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than or equal to its mean over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT remains below -30 while WORKPLACES improves above -12, commuting recovers only partially and retail trips remain suppressed relative to baseline, keeping RETAIL_REC below its last-28-day mean over four weeks.
failure_condition: TRANSIT remains below -30.0 and WORKPLACES rises above -12.0, yet mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days.
